description: This file defines a ServiceLogging class for monitoring health of services like redis and postgres, with methods for handling success and failure hooks, and initializing external loggers (Prometheus, Datadog, OpenTelemetry). It integrates with asyncio for asynchronous operations and manages external logging callbacks.

classes.name: ServiceLogging
classes.description: A class for monitoring health of services like redis and postgres, with methods for success/failure hooks and logger initialization.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes ServiceLogging instance, sets up Prometheus logger if configured.

methods.name: service_success_hook
methods.description: Handles both sync and async success monitoring by managing asyncio event loop.

methods.name: service_failure_hook
methods.description: [TODO] Not implemented for sync calls; intended for async failure monitoring.

methods.name: async_service_success_hook
methods.description: Logs successful service calls, updates external loggers based on callbacks.

methods.name: init_prometheus_services_logger_if_none
methods.description: Initializes Prometheus logger if not already initialized.

methods.name: init_datadog_logger_if_none
methods.description: Initializes Datadog logger if not already initialized.

methods.name: init_otel_logger_if_none
methods.description: Initializes OpenTelemetry logger if not already initialized.

methods.name: async_service_failure_hook
methods.description: Logs failed service calls, updates external loggers based on callbacks.

methods.name: async_post_call_failure_hook
methods.description: Tracks failed litellm-service calls, calls superclass method.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Tracks latency of litellm proxy LLM API calls.
